findings.summary: Sullivan promoted IronFX forex broker via referral links using fabricated demo account gains
findings.detail: Multiple sources report Sullivan promoted IronFX (a forex broker with documented withdrawal issues) to followers, promising access to strategies that supposedly generated wealth. IronFX provided demo accounts showing false gains. Referral/affiliate fees likely paid to Sullivan. No accounts at Exclucci Ltd or any other entity to verify inflows.

findings.summary: Exclucci Ltd (CH 14557237) dissolved via compulsory strike-off after zero statutory filings
findings.detail: Exclucci Ltd was incorporated 2022-12-23 with GBP 2 share capital (SIC 70229, management consultancy). First Gazette notice (GAZ1) issued 2024-03-12; final dissolution (GAZ2) 2024-05-28. Neither Harrison Sullivan nor Anthony Luong filed any confirmation statements or accounts in 14 months of operation.

findings.summary: HSTikkyTokky (Harrison Sullivan): two UK entities rapidly struck off/dissolved 2024-2025; FCA issued Oct 2024 warning for unauthorized financial services via FINE$$E brand
findings.detail: Harrison Sullivan (HSTikkyTokky) operated at least two rapidly-dissolved UK corporate entities: Exclucci Ltd (struck off 2024) and HS Solutions Ltd (incorporated October 2024, dissolved July 2025). His FINE$$E financial advisory brand operated without FCA authorization, prompting the UK Financial Conduct Authority to issue a public warning in October 2024 regarding unauthorized financial services. Sullivan appeared in the Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere Netflix documentary (released March 2026) and has claimed to earn £20 million/year, a figure disputed by Daily Mail investigation showing many lifestyle videos were filmed in Airbnb rentals.

findings.summary: HS Solutions Ltd (CH 16010483) incorporated four days before Sullivan's arrest warrant, dissolved nine months later
findings.detail: HS Solutions Ltd incorporated 2024-10-10 with GBP 100 share capital (SIC 63990, other information services). Arrest warrant issued 2024-10-14. Companies House applied triple default address 2025-02-24 (RP05/RP09/RP10) — consistent with Sullivan being unreachable. First Gazette notice 2025-04-15, dissolved 2025-07-08. Zero filings throughout.

findings.summary: FCA issued unauthorised-firm warning against @HSTIKKYTOKKY / FINE$$E on 17 October 2024
findings.detail: The FCA warning states: 'This firm may be providing or promoting financial services or products without our permission. You should avoid dealing with this firm and beware of scams.' Published three days after the arrest warrant (2024-10-14). No FCA Firm Reference Number exists — entity is completely unauthorised. Warning last updated 2025-03-12. Social accounts cited: TikTok @hsboxertokky; Instagram @harrisonsullivanthefirst, @hstikkytokky, @hsullivan; Telegram.

findings.summary: Pattern of serial compulsory strike-offs across all four entities indicates deliberate non-compliance with UK corporate reporting obligations
findings.detail: All four Sullivan-connected entities (Hed Fitness 2021-2023, Hed High 2022-2024, Exclucci 2022-2024, HS Solutions 2024-2025) were dissolved via compulsory strike-off for failure to file. None filed accounts. This is not coincidental — it prevents independent financial verification and limits regulatory visibility into revenues and expenses. The same pattern recurs regardless of co-directors, consistent with a deliberate operational approach.

findings.summary: Sullivan pleaded guilty to dangerous driving and driving without insurance; received suspended sentence October 2025
findings.detail: March 2024: crashed McLaren 720S on A30, Virginia Water, injuring three people. Arrest warrant issued 14 October 2024. Sullivan departed UK. Arrested 10 October 2025 after year-long manhunt. Appeared at Guildford Magistrates' Court 11 October 2025. Guilty plea. Sentence: suspended custodial, 2-year driving ban, 300 hours unpaid work, 3-month electronic curfew, 30 days rehabilitation, extended retest.

findings.summary: Claimed £3.5m Essex mansion was an Airbnb rental used as a video production set, not owned property
findings.detail: Media reporting following the Louis Theroux Netflix documentary (2026) exposed that the property Sullivan displayed in content as evidence of wealth was rented via Airbnb for filming purposes. Companies House records show no accounts filed at any of his four companies, making ownership of high-value property implausible.

findings.summary: SYSTEMIC PATTERN: Harrison Sullivan's UK entity serial dissolution mirrors Tate corporate behavior — rapid incorporation followed by compulsory strike-off after zero statutory filings, with FCA regulatory warning, suggesting a shared structural playbook for UK-domiciled high-risk financial promotion
findings.detail: Sullivan ran four UK entities all at compulsory strike-off/dissolved state: Exclucci Ltd (CH 14557237, dissolved) and HS Solutions Ltd (CH 16010483, incorporated four days before Sullivan's arrest warrant, dissolved nine months later). FCA warning issued Oct 17, 2024 for unauthorized financial services via FINE$$E brand. Promoted IronFX forex via fabricated demo account gains. Pleaded guilty to dangerous driving/no insurance Oct 2025. Tate parallel: both ecosystems show UK entities incorporated at virtual offices, rapid dissolution without statutory compliance, and FCA-adjacent regulatory exposure (Tate via offshore fundraising, Sullivan via unauthorized financial promotion). Base rate note: UK compulsory strike-offs are common for dormant/compliant-failure entities — the parallel is behavioral (FCA warning + simultaneous financial promotion), not merely structural.
